# Setup

```{r}

# set to folder where simulation results are stored
res_dir <- "/Users/simulation_results_rda/"

# set to folder where output figures should go
out_dir <- "/Users/figures/"

J <- 3
R_eval <- 30
R_vec <- rep(R_eval, J)

models <- c("hmm", "nb", "cv", "aic", "nonp")
model_lvls <- c("HMM", "nb-HSMM", "CV-HSMM", "AIC-HSMM", "qREML-HSMM")
model_cols <- c("HMM" = "#999999",
                "nb-HSMM" = "#0072B2",
                "CV-HSMM" = "#E69F00",
                "AIC-HSMM"= "#CC79A7",
                "qREML-HSMM" = "#009E73")

relab <- function(x){
  factor(x, levels = models, labels = model_lvls)}

# scenario 1-5 = medium overlap, 6-10 = high, so paired id is id+5

meta <- data.table(
  scenario_id = as.character(1:10),
  dwell = rep(1:5, 2),
  overlap = factor(rep(c("Medium", "High"), each = 5), levels = c("Medium", "High")))

tag <- function(dt){
  dt[meta, on = "scenario_id", `:=`(dwell = i.dwell, overlap = i.overlap)]
  dt[]}


```


```{r}

# function to construct the dwell time distirbution implied by the geometric tail (beyond the explicit part, but part of the fitted model)
dwell_nonp <- function(d_r_i, R, R_eval){
  out <- numeric(R_eval)
  out[1:R] <- d_r_i # explicit part (unstructured start)
  tail_mass <- max(1 - sum(d_r_i), 0) # reference category mass beyond Rvec_i
  if (R_eval > R && tail_mass > 0){
    cdf_Rm1 <- sum(d_r_i[1:(R - 1)])  # F(R-1)
    haz_R <- d_r_i[R] / (1 - cdf_Rm1)   # ci[R]
    cont <- 1 - haz_R # geometric continuation rate
    rr <- seq_len(R_eval - R)
    out[(R + 1):R_eval] <- tail_mass * (1 - cont) * cont^(rr - 1)
  }
  out
}

# build the dwell matrix over the same support as used for simulation
# needed for faithful MSSE
# makes it possible to spot a too small R_vec
build_dwell_matrix <- function(pars, model, J, R_vec, R_eval){
  D <- matrix(0, J, R_eval)
  for (i in 1:J){
    if (model == "nonp"){
      D[i, ] <- dwell_nonp(pars$d_r[[i]], R_vec[i], R_eval)
    } else if (model == "nb"){
      D[i, ] <- dnbinom(0:(R_eval - 1), mu = pars$nb_mu[i], size = pars$nb_size[i]) # shifted
    } else if (model == "hmm"){
      a_ii <- diag(pars$hmm_tpm)[i]
      D[i, ] <- dgeom(0:(R_eval - 1), p = (1 - a_ii))
    }
    D[i, ] <- D[i, ] / sum(D[i, ])
  }
  D
}


```

```{r}
# read in simulation results
runs_all <- setNames(lapply(c(1:10), function(id){
  load(file.path(res_dir, sprintf("scenario_%d_all_runs.rda", id)))
  runs
}), 1:10)
```

## Build tables


```{r}

# Sum of squared error
ise <- tag(rbindlist(lapply(runs_all, function(runs)
  rbindlist(lapply(runs, function(r)
    rbindlist(lapply(models, function(m){
      x <- r[[m]]$ise
      if (!is.list(x)) return(NULL)
      data.table(model = m, state = seq_along(x$per_state), ise = x$per_state)
    }))))), idcol = "scenario_id"))
ise[, `:=`(model = relab(model), state = paste("State", state))]

# estimated dwell-time distributions
type <- c(hmm = "hmm", nb = "nb", cv = "nonp", aic = "nonp", nonp = "nonp")
extract_dw <- function(runs, R_state){
  rbindlist(lapply(runs, function(r)
    rbindlist(lapply(names(type), function(m){
      p <- r[[m]]$pars
      if (is.null(p)) return(NULL)
      D <- build_dwell_matrix(p, type[[m]], J, rep(R_state, J), R_eval)
      data.table(model = m,
                 state = rep(seq_len(nrow(D)), times = ncol(D)),
                 duration = rep(seq_len(ncol(D)), each  = nrow(D)),
                 prob = as.vector(D))
    }))))}

dw <- rbindlist(lapply(names(runs_all), function(id)
  extract_dw(runs_all[[id]], if (id %in% c("5", "10")) 20 else 30)), # R_vec was only 20 for SPIKE scenario since this captured most of the probability mass
  idcol = "scenario_id")
dw[, scenario_id := as.character(scenario_id)]
dw <- tag(dw)

dw[, `:=`(model = relab(model), state = paste("State", state))]

# true dwell-time distributions
source("git_master_make_scenarios_complex.R")
sc_csv <- read.csv("master_scenarios_complex.csv")

pad <- function(v, n){ 
  o <- numeric(n)
  k <- min(length(v), n)
  o[seq_len(k)] <- v[seq_len(k)]
  o 
}

truth <- rbindlist(lapply(1:5, function(d){
  soj <- sojourn_distributions[[ sc_csv$sojourn[sc_csv$scenario_id == d] ]]
  D <- t(sapply(soj[1:J], function(x) pad(x / sum(x), R_eval))) # J x R_eval
  data.table(dwell = d,
             state = paste("State", rep(seq_len(J), times = R_eval)),
             duration = rep(seq_len(R_eval), each = J),
             prob = as.vector(D))
}))[, k := 1L]

grid <- CJ(overlap = factor(c("Medium", "High"), levels = c("Medium", "High")),
            model = factor(model_lvls, levels = model_lvls))[, k := 1L]
truth <- merge(truth, grid, by = "k", allow.cartesian = TRUE)[, k := NULL]

# decoding accuracy
acc <- tag(rbindlist(lapply(runs_all, function(runs)
  rbindlist(lapply(runs, function(r)
    rbindlist(lapply(models, function(m){
      g <- r[[m]]$accuracy
      l <- r[[m]]$local_accuracy
      if (is.null(g) || is.na(g[1])) return(NULL)
      data.table(model = m, Global = g, Local = l)
    }))))), idcol = "scenario_id"))

acc[, model := relab(model)]
acc <- melt(acc, id.vars = c("scenario_id", "model", "dwell", "overlap"),
            variable.name = "decoder", value.name = "acc")

# State-dependent mean bias
true_mu <- rbindlist(list(
  data.table(overlap = "Medium", variable = rep(c("Variable 1", "Variable 2"), each = J),
             state = rep(seq_len(J), 2), truth = c(0, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4)),
  data.table(overlap = "High",   variable = rep(c("Variable 1", "Variable 2"), each = J),
             state = rep(seq_len(J), 2), truth = c(0, 0.7, 1.4, 2, 2.7, 3.4))
))[, overlap := factor(overlap, levels = c("Medium", "High"))]

mu <- tag(rbindlist(lapply(runs_all, function(runs)
  rbindlist(lapply(runs, function(r)
    rbindlist(lapply(models, function(m){
      p <- r[[m]]$pars
      if (is.null(p)) return(NULL)
      data.table(model = m,
                 state = rep(seq_len(J), 2),
                 variable = rep(c("Variable 1", "Variable 2"), each = J),
                 mu = c(p$mu1, p$mu2))
    }))))), idcol = "scenario_id"))

mu[, model := relab(model)]
mu[true_mu, on = .(variable, state, overlap), err := mu - i.truth]
emis <- mu[, .(med = median(err), lo = quantile(err, .25), hi = quantile(err, .75)),
           by = .(dwell, overlap, model, state, variable)][, state := factor(state)]


# Selected lambda
pen_models <- c("cv", "aic", "nonp")
lam <- tag(rbindlist(lapply(runs_all, function(runs)
  rbindlist(lapply(runs, function(r)
    rbindlist(lapply(pen_models, function(m){
      
      x <- if (m == "nonp") r[[m]]$pars$lambda else r[[m]]$lambda
      
      if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
      
      data.table(model = m, state = seq_along(x), lambda = x)
    }))))), idcol = "scenario_id"))

lam[, `:=`(model = factor(model, levels = pen_models,
                          labels = c("CV-HSMM", "AIC-HSMM", "qREML-HSMM")),
           state = paste("State", state))]

# Run-time needed
tim <- tag(rbindlist(lapply(runs_all, function(runs)
  rbindlist(lapply(runs, function(r)
    rbindlist(lapply(models, function(m){
      e <- r[[m]]$elapsed
      if (is.null(e) || is.na(e) || e < 0.001) return(NULL) # catch potential failures
      data.table(model = m, elapsed = e)
    }))))), idcol = "scenario_id"))
tim[, model := relab(model)]


```


## Plot helpers

```{r}

theme_big <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"),   
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black"))

plot_dwell <- function(d){
  ggplot(dw[dwell == d], aes(duration, prob)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = duration, fill = model), lwd = 0.2, outlier.size = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = truth[dwell == d], linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_nested(overlap + state ~ model, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = model_cols) +
    labs(x = "Dwell duration", y = "Estimated probability") +
    theme_big +
    theme(legend.position = "none")}

plot_ise <- function(d){
  ggplot(ise[dwell == d], aes(model, sqrt(ise), fill = model)) + # take the root for better visibility
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, lwd = 0.3) +
    facet_grid(state ~ overlap) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = model_cols) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Root summed squared error") +
    theme_big +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))}

acc_rng <- range(acc$acc) # accuracy plots should share same range to ensure fair visual comparison
plot_acc <- function(d){
  ggplot(acc[dwell == d], aes(model, acc, fill = model)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, lwd = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = model_cols) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = acc_rng) +
    facet_grid(overlap ~ decoder) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Accuracy") +
    theme_big +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))}

M_emis <- emis[, max(abs(c(lo, hi)))] # same for emission plots
plot_emis <- function(d){
  ggplot(emis[dwell == d], aes(state, med, color = model)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                    position = position_dodge(0.6), size = 0.15) +
    facet_grid(overlap ~ variable) +
    scale_color_manual(values = model_cols) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-M_emis, M_emis)) +
    labs(x = "State", y = expression(hat(mu) - mu), color = NULL) +
    theme_big +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 13.2),
          legend.spacing.x = unit(1.6, "pt"),
          axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"))}

# draw inline and save the PDF in one call
emit <- function(p, file, w, h){
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, file), p, width = w, height = h)
  print(p)
  invisible(p)
}

# all four panels for one dwell scenario
panels <- function(d){
  emit(plot_dwell(d), sprintf("dwell_%d.pdf", d), 16, 10)
  emit(plot_ise(d), sprintf("root_ise_%d.pdf", d),  7,  6)
  emit(plot_acc(d), sprintf("accuracy_%d.pdf", d),  7,  6)
  emit(plot_emis(d), sprintf("emis_%d.pdf", d),  7,  6)
}
```

# Runtime

```{r}

p_tim <- ggplot(tim, aes(x = model, y = (elapsed/60), fill = model)) + # plot in minutes
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(. ~ overlap) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_cols) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Runtime in minutes") +
  theme_big +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

emit(p_tim, "runtime.pdf", 7, 4)

timtab <- tim[, .(median_m = median(elapsed) / 60,
                  q25 = quantile(elapsed, .25) / 60,
                  q75 = quantile(elapsed, .75) / 60), by = model]

timtab[, ratio := median_m / median_m[model == "qREML-HSMM"]] # ratios relative to qREML-HSMM

timtab[, cell  := sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", median_m, q25, q75)]

print(xtable(timtab[, .(model, cell, ratio)], digits = c(2, 2, 2, 2),
             caption = "Runtime per fit (min), pooled across all scenarios. Median [IQR]; ratio relative to qREML-HSMM.", label = "tab:runtime"), booktabs = TRUE, include.rownames = FALSE)

```

# Plot for lambda

```{r}

# adjust size a bit
theme_big <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9.3, colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black"))


p_lam <- ggplot(lam[lambda > 0], aes(model, lambda, fill = model)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4) +
  facet_nested(dwell + overlap ~ state,
               labeller = labeller(dwell = c("1" = "Baseline", "2" = "One-NB",
                                             "3" = "One-MIX", "4" = "NB-PEAK",
                                             "5" = "All-PEAK"))) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = 10^(0:6),
                labels = scales::label_math(10^.x)(0:6),
                expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.12))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1, 1e6)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_cols[c("CV-HSMM", "AIC-HSMM", "qREML-HSMM")]) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression("Chosen smoothing parameter " * lambda)) +
  theme_big +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

emit(p_lam, "lambda_all.pdf", 8, 11)


```


# Create latex tables


```{r}

# state-dependent SD estimates
sig <- tag(rbindlist(lapply(runs_all, function(runs)
  rbindlist(lapply(runs, function(r)
    rbindlist(lapply(models, function(m){
      p <- r[[m]]$pars
      if (is.null(p)) return(NULL)
      data.table(model = m,
                 state = rep(seq_len(J), 2),
                 variable = rep(c("Variable 1", "Variable 2"), each = J),
                 sd = c(p$sigma1, p$sigma2))
    }))))), idcol = "scenario_id"))

sig[, model := relab(model)]
sig[, err := sd - 1] # true sd is one always

```


```{r}

# mean sum of squared errors
# multiplied by 1000
mise <- ise[, .(mise = 1000 * mean(ise), mcse = 1000 * (sd(ise) / sqrt(.N))),
            by = .(overlap, dwell, model, state)]
mise[, cell := sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mise, mcse)]

print(xtable(dcast(mise, dwell + model ~ overlap + state, value.var = "cell"),
             caption = "MSSE x1000 (MCSE), both overlaps.", label = "tab:mise"),
      booktabs = TRUE, include.rownames = FALSE, size = "\\footnotesize")

# accuracy
accs <- acc[, .(acc = 100 * mean(acc)), by = .(overlap, dwell, model, decoder)]
print(xtable(dcast(accs, overlap + decoder + model ~ dwell, value.var = "acc"),
             caption = "Decoding accuracy (%).", label = "tab:acc", digits = 2),
      booktabs = TRUE, include.rownames = FALSE)

# MAE
mae <- rbind(
  mu [, .(v = mean(abs(err))), by = .(overlap, dwell, model, state, variable)][, par := "Mean"],
  sig[, .(v = mean(abs(err))), by = .(overlap, dwell, model, state, variable)][, par := "SD"])
mae[, cell := formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 3)]


for (pp in c("Mean", "SD"))
  print(xtable(dcast(mae[par == pp], dwell + model ~ overlap + variable + state, value.var = "cell"),
               caption = sprintf("MAE of estimated state %ss, both overlaps.", tolower(pp)),
               label = sprintf("tab:mae-%s", tolower(pp))),
        booktabs = TRUE, include.rownames = FALSE, size = "\\footnotesize")

```
